minutes.headline: Conservation Commission required a full notice of intent for the DPW fuel tank replacement, 6-1, and approved several septic and driveway filings.
minutes.summary: The commission met remotely and heard the 994 Northfield Road land acquisition update, Hickory Hills lake testing changes, and several wetlands hearings. The main debate was the DPW's above-ground fuel tanks near Mopus Brook, where members voted a positive determination requiring a notice of intent. It also reviewed the enforcement case at 179-183 Island Road, where it asked for an as-built survey and a restoration plan before any work, and continued the DPW culvert and 11 Willow Circle matters to May 6.

public_comment.topic: Commended the commission on the DPW fuel tank proximity to the brook, asked about grant money versus tank removal cost, asked for a professional site review of alternative locations, and said the town should not be in the fuel storage business.
Paula said upstream homes cannot get boats out because of fill in the channel and asked for silt fence in front of the straw waddle at Island Road.
Joan P raised concern about sediment and nutrient runoff into the lake and urged prompt revegetation of the 30 and 50 foot zones.

votes.motion: Accept the field change to the Hickory Hills water quality testing procedures as presented.
Approve the septic upgrade application at 120 Sunset Lane as presented.
Authorize the agent to sign the order of conditions for 120 Sunset Lane.
Approve the septic replacement at 12 Pine Acres under the local bylaw.
Make a positive determination on the DPW fuel tank RDA at 520 Chase Road, requiring a notice of intent.
Approve the common driveway at 335 Chase Road with boulders every 20 feet along the 50 foot line and revegetation with an agreed seed mix.
Approve 335 Chase Road Lot 2 with rip rap added at the drain outlet.
Approve 335 Chase Road Lot 3 with the same boulder and seed mix conditions.
Authorize the agent to sign the orders of conditions for the three 335 Chase Road filings.
Approve the 1325 Mass Ave earth removal and stormwater filing as submitted.
Authorize the agent to sign the order of conditions for 1325 Mass Ave.
Continue the DPW culvert notice of intent for Sunset Lane and Northfield Road to May 6.
Approve the field change for 15 Cliff View deck post repair.
Send a certified demand letter to the owner of 164 Page Street to remove the trailer from the 30 foot no touch zone by May 6 or face fines.

budget_items.topic: DPW fuel tank replacement state earmark
budget_items.what_was_said: The DPW director said the state earmark for the tank project is now understood not to expire June 30, easing time pressure.
The engineer said town funding for the project has to be used by a certain date.
The chair said local regulations allow daily fines per violation, though no fines were moved.
The lake association said lab analysis is the biggest expense of the new testing plan, and equipment must be purchased.

decisions.decision: Agent and a couple of members will do a site walk at 11 Willow Circle Saturday at 9 am.
Straw poll showed a majority would consider the proposed fuel tank location if properly designed; the DPW was told to proceed with a notice of intent.
The Mopus Brook crossing repair is to be included in the same notice of intent, with any emergency work documented.
The chair will email DPW for a written status on the Sunset Lane and Northfield Road culverts before May 6.
Agent to send instructions to the engineer for an existing-conditions survey and restoration plan for 179-183 Island Road; the owner consented and will install silt fence.
Fines at Island Road were tabled; work is to wait for the plan to be reviewed on May 6.
April 1 minutes not approved pending revisions.

what_happened.line: The commission voted 6-1 for a positive determination on the DPW fuel tank replacement at 520 Chase Road, so a full notice of intent is required.
A straw poll showed a majority would consider the proposed tank location if properly designed; the Mopus Brook crossing repair is to join the same notice of intent.
On the 179-183 Island Road enforcement case, the owner consented to an existing-conditions survey and restoration plan; fines were tabled until review on May 6.
The commission approved septic and driveway filings at 120 Sunset Lane, 12 Pine Acres and 335 Chase Road, and continued 11 Willow Circle and the DPW culvert filing to May 6.
A certified demand letter will go to the owner of 164 Page Street to remove a trailer from the 30 foot no touch zone by May 6 or face fines.

why_it_matters: The DPW fuel tank sits near Mopus Brook, and the notice of intent means a fuller wetlands review before the town builds it, which affects the timing and cost of a town-funded project.
The Island Road and Page Street cases show how the commission enforces the 30 and 50 foot buffer zones, which protect the lake and apply to any lakeside property owner.
watch_next: May 6: continued hearings on 11 Willow Circle and the DPW culverts at Sunset Lane and Northfield Road, review of the Island Road restoration plan, and the 164 Page Street trailer deadline.
A written status from DPW on the Sunset Lane and Northfield Road culverts, which the chair will request before May 6.
